name: Answers
description: A Stack-Overflow-style Question & Answer (Q&A) system for Drupal, built on core node, comment and taxonomy entities.
project_description: Answers is a Question & Answer (Q&A) system for Drupal that aims to reproduce the core Stack Overflow experience: users post questions, other users post answers, and both questions and answers can be commented on. In the 2.x line the project is a thin umbrella module that simply depends on and enables its single shipped submodule, answers_core, which contains all of the actual functionality. The implementation is built entirely on Drupal core primitives rather than custom entities: a 'Question' is an answers_question node type, an 'Answer' is a comment of bundle answers_answer attached to the question via the node's 'answers' comment field, questions carry a free-tagging 'answers_tags' taxonomy reference (Tags vocabulary), and threaded comments on questions and answers use additional comment bundles (answers_question_comment, answers_comment). answers_core adds a custom AnswersFormatter comment field formatter, a set of Twig template overrides and a small CSS/JS library that reveal inline comment forms. Older 7.x supporting features such as voting, best-answer selection and UserPoints reputation are NOT part of this shipped codebase. There are no custom routes, permissions, services or database queries; access control, posting and moderation are governed entirely by Drupal core's node and comment permissions and access handlers.
